summary: Iteration 31 — Validated NUA brand identity, dark/light theme toggle, Products dynamic categories + multi-modifier picker (backend + UI), backend Product model categoryId + modifierIds, v25/v26 page-split refactor (21 + 5 files via barrel re-export), POS Terminal render. Backend: 7/7 pytest PASS (100%) including categoryId/modifierIds POST + PUT + GET persistence + empty list. Frontend: theme toggle flips body bg between exact NUA colors #f6f7fb -> #0b0b0f via dock-theme-toggle, Products dialog renders dynamic product-category-select + product-modifiers-picker with 12 mod-toggles selectable, POS terminal renders cart + dock + Table/Takeaway/Walk-in picker, modifiers page renders 12+ modifier cards. ONE CRITICAL BUG FOUND: /staff-availability route crashes with 'staff.filter is not a function' producing a blank page — root cause is wrong localStorage key (uses 'token' instead of actual 'nuva_token' set by login), causing the fetch to /api/auth/users to receive an auth-error object which is then set as the staff array.

ui_bugs.issue: Page crashes with 'staff.filter is not a function' — blank page rendered. Root cause: line 18 reads localStorage.getItem('token') but login stores token under key 'nuva_token'. Auth header becomes 'Bearer null', /api/auth/users returns an error object (not an array), which is then setStaff()'d. Subsequent staff.filter(...) crashes the component subtree.

issues: Sign In button is emerald green instead of NUA brand orange (#f58c14). Other branded buttons in the app (Run Simulation, Add Product, dock star icon) correctly use #f58c14. Login page appears to use hardcoded Tailwind emerald instead of theme.primary.
~8 repeated 404 console errors on every page load (same as iteration 29/30 — empty src='' image issue, carried over).

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix /app/frontend/src/pages/v26/StaffAvailability.jsx line 18 — change localStorage.getItem('token') to localStorage.getItem('nuva_token'), AND add defensive guard: `.then(r => r.json()).then(d => setStaff(Array.isArray(d) ? d : []))`. The same key mismatch may exist in other v25/v26 pages — grep the whole frontend for `localStorage.getItem('token')` and migrate to 'nuva_token'.
MINOR: Apply NUA brand primary color (theme.primary or #f58c14) to the /login Sign In button — currently emerald green, inconsistent with the rest of the app.
CLEANUP: Investigate the empty-src image 404s (carried over from iter 29/30) — find component rendering and add a fallback or omit when src is missing.
critical_code_review_comments: Token key inconsistency across frontend — login stores 'nuva_token' in localStorage but StaffAvailability.jsx reads 'token'. Need a centralized auth helper (e.g., getAuthToken()) to avoid this drift; many other pages probably make the same mistake silently when the backend tolerates anonymous reads.

StaffAvailability.jsx line 19 does `.then(setStaff)` directly — must validate the response shape. Add `Array.isArray(d) ? d : []` defensive default. Same defensive pattern recommended for any fetch().then(setState) in the codebase.

Products.jsx duplicate state for category — keeps both `category` (name string) and `categoryId` (id). handleCategoryChange syncs them but any direct setProductForm({category: ...}) elsewhere would diverge. Consider deriving `category` from categoryId+categories list at render time instead of storing both.

Backend products.py PUT update_data uses `if v is not None` filter — this means a caller cannot explicitly clear modifierIds back to [] via PUT (an empty list is treated as 'don't change'). Actually empty list `[]` is not None so it works — verified in test_empty_modifier_ids_allowed PASS. OK but a comment explaining the semantic helps.
Login page Sign In button color drift from NUA brand orange suggests the login form is not wired to ThemeContext or is using a literal Tailwind class instead of style={{background: theme.primary}}.

Dark/light theme toggle on dock confirmed flipping body bg to exact NUA palette (#f6f7fb light / #0b0b0f dark). rca of the issue: BUG: /staff-availability blank page. Repro: log in as owner -> navigate to /staff-availability -> page renders empty (0 chars body text). Console shows: 'PAGEERR: staff.filter is not a function'. RCA: /app/frontend/src/pages/v26/StaffAvailability.jsx:18 reads `localStorage.getItem('token')`, but login (and the rest of the app) stores the JWT under key 'nuva_token' (confirmed via Object.keys(localStorage) = ['nua_lang','nuva_token','nua-device-id','nua_dark','posTheme']). Thus the Authorization header becomes 'Bearer null', the backend returns an auth-error JSON object {detail: 'Not authenticated'}, the component calls setStaff(<object>), and the subsequent `.filter(...)` call throws a TypeError that crashes the component subtree (React renders nothing). Mitigation: (1) read the correct key 'nuva_token', and (2) guard with `Array.isArray(d) ? d : []` before setStaff. Both fixes are 1-line each in StaffAvailability.jsx.
